title: Strutinsky's shell correction as the categorical residue sum
html:
Remark. Strutinsky's shell correction as the categorical residue sum

Remark. The Strutinsky shell-correction method decomposes nuclear binding energies as

  E \;=\; \tilde E \;+\; \delta E_{\mathrm{shell}},

with \tilde E a smoothed liquid-drop piece and \delta E_{\mathrm{shell}} an oscillating microscopic correction. This decomposition is the physics shadow of the filtered-algebra identity

  \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w, q_0)
  \;=\;
  \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{gr}}(\sigma(T_w), q_0)
  \;+\;
  \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{GB}}(T_w, q_0)

from (graded-trace residue split).

Identification.

Strutinsky (physics) Categorical (algebra)
Smoothed level density \tilde\rho(E) Symbol map \sigma: J^\ell \to J^\ell/J^{\ell+1}
Liquid-drop energy \tilde E Graded trace \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{gr}}(\sigma(T_w), q_0)
Oscillating correction \delta E_{\mathrm{shell}} Residue sum \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{GB}}(T_w, q_0)
Gaussian smoothing width Filtration step J^\ell / J^{\ell+1} granularity
Magic-number enhancement Rectangular-partition spike in w_\lambda(q_0)

Exactness of the analogy. The Strutinsky smoothing averages over an energy window spanning major shells. This is equivalent to projecting onto the filtration quotient \mathrm{gr}\,H_n(q). The oscillations encode the Gröbner–Shirshov rewriting defects lost by the symbol map. Thus, \delta E_{\mathrm{shell}} = \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{GB}}. The Strutinsky prescription is the unique trace decomposition dictated by the filtered-algebra structure.

Corollaries.

  1. Strutinsky's method is forced by the filtered-algebra structure. Any alternative macroscopic-microscopic split implicitly chooses a different filtration on H_n(q). The confinement filtration (confinement level) is canonical, rendering the Strutinsky decomposition canonical.
  2. The shell correction \delta E_{\mathrm{shell}} is computable without a phenomenological single-particle potential. It is exactly the residue sum (GB residue spectral sum) applied to the atomic braid. Magic-number enhancements arise algebraically when \lambda is rectangular and H_q(\lambda) factorises (shell–Schur–Weyl self-duality).

Scope. This identification frames the algebraic structure but does not replace a quantitative calculation. A direct numerical comparison between Strutinsky \delta E_{\mathrm{shell}} at deformation \beta_2 and \mathrm{Res}_{\mathrm{GB}} provides the natural next observational test.
